reviews.text: This place is really pretty and I really love this place. My friends and me came here yesterday. The food is superb, the service is impeccable (mostly) and...
Went there for the first time Saturday Evening,everything is great, the ambiance is outstanding for this location, tried the mulliatawny soup for starters...
I came in here for the $9.95 lunch buffet the day after it opened.  It is the old Tara space and I like how it has been opened up to accommodate many more...
